entry.name: FEEL-Benchmark
entry.title: FEEL-Benchmark: Egocentric Tactile-Visual Manipulation Dataset
entry.summary: Two PaXini PX6AX-GEN3 fingertip force modules on a bare right hand (thumb and index tips; middle and little tips in 7 trials), recorded with Project Aria RGB video and MPS fingertip positions while 4 collectors picked up bottles, jelly, sponges, cups, Want Want cans and chips.
entry.hand: Bare right hand with 2 PaXini PX6AX-GEN3-DP-S2015-Elite fingertip modules

sensor.note: Per module and video frame: force_total = |(Fx, Fy, Fz)| and force_xyz (Fx, Fy, Fz) in raw signed 16-bit counts in the module's own frame, linearly interpolated onto the 10 fps video grid from ~900 Hz logs (2026-01 to 05) or ~91 Hz logs (2026-08; 50 ms host-time resolution on 2026-08-07). Modules sit on thumb + index tips in 45 trials and middle + little tips in the 7 trials of 2026-08-05/06. The hardware also reports per-taxel forces; they are not released.

scale.text: ~2.8 h (168.7 min), 3,317 episodes in 52 trials, 101,219 frames at 10 fps, 7 object categories, 4 collectors; mean episode 3.1 s, longest 12.5 s

entry.access: Hugging Face FeelAuthors/FEEL-Benchmark, ungated, 4.6 GB in LeRobot v3.0 format (one parquet + one mp4 per episode).
caveats: Anonymous upload: account FeelAuthors (full name 'Authors', created 2026-05-07, one dataset); no paper, authors or affiliation.

No stated link to FEEL (UMD, arXiv 2603.15847): different sensors (2 PaXini modules vs 6 FlexiForce sensors per glove), collectors, objects and file format. The two share the name and the Project Aria camera.
Force is in raw counts, not newtons; the axes are each module's local frame and its orientation on the finger was not recorded.
Columns action.tactile.left/right are modules 1 and 2 on one right hand, and which fingers they sit on changes by session (see sensor note).
Episodes are 0.8-12.5 s segments with gaps of 7-13 s between them (checked in Want_Milk_collectorC); the continuous trial recordings are not released.
Videos are MPEG-4 Part 2 at 10 fps; 28 episodes in 3 trials also carry an .h264.mp4 copy.
Some trial names and task strings disagree: Half_water_collectorC_3 and sponge_collectorD_2 are labelled 'pick up the jelly', sponge_collectorB_1 and the water_p25 trials 'pick up the bottle'.
MPS fingertip positions are NaN for whole episodes in 5 Collector C trials (e.g. Jelly_collectorC_5, Sponge_collectorC_2, Quarter_water_collectorC_2).
Sponge, chip and most Collector D episodes peak below ~20 counts; Want Want Milk and Wangzai episodes reach ~130-140.

tracking.note: right thumb tip (landmark 4) and index tip (landmark 8) xyz in the Aria world frame + pinch distance; NaN when the hand is not tracked; other landmarks, left hand, gaze, device pose and IMU not exported

https://huggingface.co/datasets/FeelAuthors/FEEL-Benchmark meta/episodes.jsonl of all 52 trials; meta/episodes parquet and episodes 0-2 of 20260506/Want_Milk_collectorC_lerobot; the 2 longest episode parquets of every trial (104 files)
unconfirmed: Anonymous-submission status is inferred: the FeelAuthors account was created 2026-05-07 09:21 UTC, the day the anonymous PULSE dataset (which states NeurIPS 2026 E&D double-blind review) was uploaded; the FEEL-Benchmark card names no venue or review.

Relation to FEEL (UMD) checked by comparing cards, papers and files only; the card does not expand 'FEEL' or cite arXiv 2603.15847. FEEL-Benchmark's first upload (2026-05-07) predates edessa/feel (2026-06-26).
Aria generation not stated; 1408x1408 RGB matches Aria Gen 1.
objects=7 is the card's object-category count (Bottle, Jelly, Sponge, Water, Wangzai, Chip, Coke); fill-level and empty/full variants are counted once.
tasks=1: the 21 task strings are all 'pick up <object>' variants.
Episode lengths from the 52 meta/episodes.jsonl files: 8-125 frames; 31 episodes reach 10 s, all in Collector C trials of 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-28.
Scan of the 2 longest episodes per trial (104 parquets): force_total peaks range 0.8-143 counts; 'contact' below means force_total > 10 counts.
The card gives no Chinese text; the object names (Want Want Milk, Wangzai) are Want Want brand products and PaXini is a Chinese sensor maker. Collection location not stated; no zh entry.

sample.fetch_estimate: ~26 MB: 8 episode parquets (8-13 KB each) + 8 mp4s (1.2-10.7 MB; HF tree sizes). Videos are MPEG-4 Part 2 and need re-encoding to H.264 (~1-3 MB per clip expected).
sample.rules_applied: The release labels 21 task strings (all pick-up), more than 6, so 8 are taken: one per object category (Bottle twice: full bottle and 75% bottle; Jelly, Water, Coke, Wangzai, Chip, Sponge), covering all 4 collectors and both module placements. Within each task the longest scanned episode with force_total > 10 counts for 1 s or more and valid hand tracking was chosen.
deviations: Episodes are shorter than the 10 s minimum: the release has no episode longer than 12.5 s and the segments are not contiguous, so episodes are taken whole (2.9-11.0 s).
Chip (module 2) and sponge (module 2) stay below 1 s of contact; both are soft or light objects and no scanned episode of these tasks does better on both modules.
